constraints: Front and back use the same mesh detail and texture

prompts.portal:
Use case: background-extraction.
Input image is the user's visual reference and edit target.
Extract and faithfully reconstruct ONLY the large glowing ornate portal in the foreground as a production game asset, isolated on truly transparent alpha. Remove the person and reconstruct the occluded left base. Remove all roads, railings, background, UI, dates and lettering.
Preserve precisely its elegant ivory stone arch with layered champagne gold molding, sculpted pilasters, engraved acanthus vines, wing-like ornaments at both upper sides, and the large four-point gold star on the crown. Keep the turquoise glowing watery portal with tiny golden stars and ethereal city visible inside.
Correct perspective to a symmetrical straight-on orthographic FRONT elevation for 3D modeling. Entire door including small square pedestal bases visible, centered portrait canvas with a little transparent padding. Preserve the original tall slender proportions and all fine sculpted ornament, avoid making it squat. Detailed physically convincing stone and gold, not plastic, not simple tubes. Light warm from upper left but not overexposed. No floor shadow or background glow outside the portal, no text.
prompts.road:
Use case: background-extraction.
Input image is the user's visual reference and edit target.
Extract and reconstruct a single modular section of the ornate ivory marble bridge road AND both carved balustrades, isolated on genuine transparent alpha, as a high-quality 3D modeling reference. Remove character, doors, all dates/UI and entire sky/background. Show one 8m wide x 8m long section, three-quarter view slightly from above, full edges visible. Faithfully preserve the reference aesthetic: individually fitted warm ivory stone paving slabs, thin engraved champagne-gold inlay lines and one delicate compass medallion; refined stone balustrades with small carved open arches, broad rounded stone handrails and square piers with ornate gold lotus finials. Sunlight warm on upper left, polished stone reflections restrained. Fine pores, marble veins, layered stone bevels, carved botanical relief, gold seams; realistic elegant fantasy craftsmanship, no chunky simple railings, no turned spindles. No text, labels, background or objects beyond the requested road.
prompts.dark: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is the edited glowing portal asset. Make the INACTIVE version of this EXACT asset. Keep identical image dimensions, framing, location, geometry, silhouette and ornamental details pixel-aligned. Change only lighting/material state: turn OFF all emission, bloom, edge light, stars and magic. Interior becomes a quiet charcoal silver-grey opaque glass mirror with subtle etched swirls. Frame becomes muted grey marble with aged silver-gold carvings. Crown star also unlit. Exterior background must be completely transparent alpha, with NO ground or surrounding glow/shadow. No text. Do not move, redesign or resize anything.
prompts.frame: Use case: background-extraction. Input is an ornate glowing portal asset, front elevation. Produce the EXACT SAME door frame as a clean texture/modeling asset with transparent background AND a completely empty TRANSPARENT INNER OPENING. Remove ONLY magic, portal city, glass, emission, bloom and light halos. The same carved ivory marble pilasters, gold acanthus tracery, same wing ornaments, same layered rounded arch, same four-point star crown and same square bases remain in exactly their current position. Keep identical canvas size, proportions and all edges pixel-aligned. Neutral even warm studio light, no white-hot highlights. True alpha outside AND through the door hole. No floor, no shadow, no checkerboard, no colored background. This is for projecting onto real double-sided geometry.
prompts.side: Use case: stylized-concept. Input is the exact portal front elevation to match. Create one clean orthographic RIGHT SIDE elevation as a modeling reference on transparent alpha. This is a freestanding gate: FRONT AND BACK ARE IDENTICAL, mirrored through its thickness. Thickness is 0.55 meters for a 6.4m tall door. Both faces repeat the same gold star crown, pilaster capitals and decorative gold scrolls. The side reveals layered stone arch construction, beveled edges and thin gold inset channels, not a blank slab. The portal plane is recessed in the middle of the thickness. The turquoise light and gold trim emit a soft glow at the central opening, no exterior halo. Full height visible, exact same proportions and details as reference. No floor or captions.
prompts.paving: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input is a bridge module modeling reference. Create the ROAD SURFACE ONLY as a perfectly flat orthographic TOP-DOWN square tile for a real game PBR material, filling the image edge-to-edge, opaque. Remove all railing, pillars, finials, sidewall and surroundings. Reconstruct the same elegant fitted ivory marble paving slabs, fine champagne-gold inlay around rounded diamond geometric borders and the central fine circular compass star medallion. Seamless vertical tiling: top and bottom edge patterns match. The carving is fine and delicate. Neutral diffuse lighting without cast shadows, perspective, reflections or baked highlights. Natural restrained marble veins and tiny pores; gold is subdued champagne. No text, no bevel around outer image, no empty margins.
